---
title: "Australian Economists Repudiate Kyoto"
date: "2007-05-28"
categories: ["Culture & Society", "Economics", "Politics"]
---

The latest media [stunt](http://www.tai.org.au/index.php?option=com_remository&Itemid=36&func=fileinfo&id=1016 "stunt") by the anti-modernist Australia Institute has backfired, with Warwick McKibbin noting on ABC Radio that only 10% of those eligible to sign the economists’ petition in support of Kyoto actually did so.  McKibbin was a particularly notable non-signatory, given his [expertise](http://www.sensiblepolicy.com/ "expertise") in climate change policy. 

**UPDATE:**  [Damien Eldridge](http://economicsgeek.blogspot.com/2007/05/explanation-of-my-decision-not-to-add.html "Damien Eldridge") explains his reasons for not signing.
